title: Funeral Sandwiches
description: Funeral sandwiches made with ham and Swiss cheese on soft rolls are brushed with a mustard and poppy seed butter, then baked until golden and gooey!
ingredients: 2 (12 count) packages Hawaiian bread rolls (such as King's®)

steps.text: Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place ham and Swiss cheese slices on the bottom of each bread roll and cover with tops; arrange rolls in an even layer on the prepared sheet.
Mix butter, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard, and poppy seeds together in a small bowl; spoon over sandwich tops. Let sit for 10 minutes or up to 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven, uncovered, until golden on top and cheese is melted, about 12 to 18 minutes.

video.description: Contrary to what the name suggests, these delicious party sliders can be enjoyed on happy occasions too! In this video, Natalie quickly throws together a tray of poppy seed-sprinkled funeral sandwiches with salty, savory, and sweet flavors. These bite-sized ham and cheese sandwiches are made with Hawaiian rolls serving as the buns. After being brushed with a buttery mixture, the funeral sandwiches are baked in the oven for around 15 minutes before being served to a hungry crowd of partygoers or mourners.
